notes: The margin Or, lay upon was read and set aside; the printed offer thee governs (rule 38).
עַל and the dative לְ are unrepresented because the ASV writes bare English indirect objects for them (rule 40), while their suffixes take the pronouns written for them (rule 18).
The it of that I may do it is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).
